rule.title: Nominalisation and formal register
rule.explanation:
En informes, presentaciones y textos académicos el inglés formal convierte verbos y adjetivos en nombres. A eso se le llama nominalización, y hace el texto más objetivo y denso:
- «grow» → «growth», «decide» → «decision», «intend» → «intention», «improve» → «improvement»
- «fail» → «failure», «increase» → «an increase», «reduce» → «a reduction», «develop» → «development»
- «able» → «ability», «important» → «importance», «available» → «availability», «likely» → «likelihood»

Patrones típicos:
- «the» + nombre + «of»: «the failure of the old site», «the development of the app»
- «a» + adjetivo + nombre: «a significant increase», «a sharp decline»
- «lead to» / «result in» (provocar), «be due to» (deberse a): «Improved usability led to more bookings.»
- verbos de poco contenido + nombre: «make a decision», «carry out an analysis», «experience growth»

Compara:
- «We grew really fast.» (coloquial) → «The studio experienced rapid growth.» (formal)
- «Bookings went up a lot.» → «There was a significant increase in bookings.»

Ojo: con el nombre, el adverbio pasa a ser adjetivo: «grew rapidly» → «rapid growth».

sets.instructions: Completa con el nombre o la preposición.

items.sentence: The studio experienced rapid ___ last year. (grow)
answers: growth

items.sentence: Our ___ to partner with Grace was based on a shared vision. (decide)
answers: decision

items.sentence: Our ___ is to expand into the Spanish market. (intend)
answers: intention

items.sentence: Improved usability led ___ a significant increase in bookings.
answers: to

items.sentence: There was a significant ___ in bookings. (increase)
answers: increase

items.sentence: The ___ of the old website cost us clients. (fail)
answers: failure

items.sentence: We noticed a clear ___ in speed. (improve)
answers: improvement

items.sentence: The new design resulted ___ more bookings.
answers: in

items.sentence: There has been a sharp ___ in costs. (reduce)
answers: reduction

items.sentence: The ___ of the new app took six months. (develop)
answers: development

items.sentence: The ___ of rooms depends on the season. (available)
answers: availability

items.sentence: Everyone understands the ___ of good design. (important)
answers: importance
